Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
My Lord and your Lord is Allah, the Lord of the worlds
O Allah, make this month begin for us with security and faith
And haste towards what You love and are pleased with

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيْ شَهْرِنَا هٰذَا
Translation: O Allah, bless us in this month of ours
And grant us its goodness and help

Arabic text: وَاصْرِفْ عَنَّا ضُرَّهُ وَشَرَّهُ وَبَلاءَهُ وَفِتْنَتَهُ
Translation: And turn away from us its harm, evil, affliction, and trial
